detail: campaign-retire currently rejects a reservation when all child worktrees have already been resolved, even when archived hand-backs and landing evidence are complete. Implement a bounded Manager-only reconciliation path that archives the stale reservation and preserves every receipt, while refusing any active child, invalid seal, manifest digest drift, or unresolved provenance. This is distinct from selector projection ticket IMP-20260819-1df6a3.
plan: 1. Add a pure reconciliation contract for resolved-only campaign reservations. 2. Make campaign-retire or an explicit recovery primitive archive the reservation only after all child records are resolved and receipts are valid. 3. Preserve refusal for active, dirty, missing, stale, or mismatched provenance. 4. Add focused lifecycle tests for resolved-only cleanup, active-child refusal, digest mismatch refusal, and atomic no-mutation failure.
